name: Octant-based Black Component Counting
definition: An efficient algorithm to count the number of black components in N26(P) by dividing the neighborhood into 8 overlapping octants and using a lookup table based on octant occupancy states.
summary: Octant-based Black Component Counting efficiently counts foreground components by aggregating 26 neighbors into 8 octants and using a lookup table to reject non-simple points, reducing the search space for topology-preserving thinning.
